title: Mid-year population estimates for the UK, mid-2025 (MYE2, all ages)
refresh: Yearly, published around June–July. Change the mid2025/mye25 parts of the URL to the new year, re-run, and update vintage.
attribution: Source: Office for National Statistics licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Contains data from National Records of Scotland and the Northern Ireland Statistics and Research Agency.
caveats: One point per local authority (361), placed at ONS's label point for that authority.
